The *Adhikaraṇavāra* is the fourteenth section of the first division of the *Parivāra*, the closing analytical compendium of the Pali Vinaya Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Functioning as a technical monastic catechism, the text systematically classifies and relates the various rules and disciplinary offenses of the Vinaya to the four established categories of legal procedure (*adhikaraṇa*) [SuttaCentral]. A complete modern English translation has been produced by Bhikkhu Brahmali [SuttaCentral].
